name: First Night Last Night
source:
Wake up darling.

The night has a necklace of stars and a dress of black velvet.

Let's rip its throat out.

[From [url=https://opensorcerygames.itch.io/first-night-last-night]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
醒来吧亲爱的。

夜晚有一条星星项链和一条黑色天鹅绒连衣裙。

让我们撕开它的喉咙吧。

[来自[url=https://opensorcerygames.itch.io/first-night-last-night]itch.io[/url]]
